title: Dubai BitClub Network Event
description: Don't miss this great opportunity to become part of our amazing founding team. WhatsApp: [PHONE] Click and ...

asr.full_text: I was very excited with the first video and decided to make the second one because I want to take the time to record it Hi, how are you? Augusto Mermezo is greeting you Today we are in the Grand Hyatt In a very small place, in a big part of a hotel, the place where there's a macro event full of more than 600 million people people that changed their lives, with a mining club, to which my friend Santa and me belong. It's a bit peculiar how we met the club, how Santa met the club, I would like this person, that you see. He is making thousands of people change their financial situation. He is a monster, he has created more than 1000 people who are already mining at this club. that is how are changing their economic situation. I would like that he gives us some tips why we have chosen the club and what are we doing with him. a machine that applied for money. This was our first step. I was told that I was going to be phony, I was asked to forgive for my voice. The truth is we have talked a lot these days and we have had a great time. But I found out that I could gather a plan to have 100 bitcoins for 180 days. We added some people to that, we made robots make money, but then we traded them, and that trading made us do more comical operations, buy more robots, and we created a plan that was indeed spectacular, for the next six months to 180 days, creating people who now had financial freedom. What have we found in this plan and in this road is that, in addition, MixClub is a spectacular company. In the last years they have made more than 100 million people, we are talking of a company that in 3-4 years really has achieved more than 5 people that make a million per month, more than 10 that make 100-500 thousand per month And more than 100 that make 100.000 to 300.000 subscribers per month And these are the reasons of the greatest opportunities to generate money! In fact, we need an entire package that's not a bad idea that supports a lot of people with financial difficulties working a lot like you We invite you to participate because it's more than just I'm saying that from the bottom of my heart with the emotions I'm feeling what's happening is spectacular And all this I don't know if you have got it Santa has told us that in the next 5 years this company would make more billionaires and the question, and I think we have to finish with this, the question is you are crazy about what are you making? So we are going to say goodbye with a big hug. Yes! ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes joining a mining club through extraordinary wealth claims, including a plan to have 100 bitcoins in 180 days and claims of financial freedom. The speakers present the opportunity positively, show luxury-event imagery, invite viewers to participate, and direct them to WhatsApp, encouraging recruitment into the promoted scheme.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central promoted mechanism is a mining-club opportunity tied to mining robots and recurring financial returns. The video links participation in the club with a claimed 100-bitcoin plan, people changing their financial situation, and financial freedom, which fits paid mining or node returns. The supplied content does not show a completed loss or specify the required payment, but it does show active promotion of the return-generating mining opportunity.
